retrievalProfile.description: A 1960s-inspired minimalist layout featuring a stylized bouquet of hearts tied with a geometric ribbon, utilizing high-contrast sans-serif and serif typography on a textured cream background.

recipe.visualDefinition: A clean, off-white composition centered around a graphic bouquet where individual red and orange hearts act as floral heads, supported by thin black stems and anchored by a thick, angular maroon bow. The typography is distributed across the top half in a mix of bold extended sans-serif and light serif faces.
coreVisualRelationships: Asymmetrical typographic balance against a centered graphic
Layered transparency in the heart shapes
Contrast between thin line-work and heavy block lettering
coreInvariants: Overlapping heart shapes with varying shades of red
Mix of extended sans-serif and traditional serif fonts

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The heart bouquet is the central visual anchor, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark maroon geometric bow at the bottom center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large title text, move down through the secondary text, follow the stems to the bow, and then fan out with the hearts.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open space on the left and right margins to emphasize the verticality of the bouquet.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep red and orange for the hearts
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Maroon for the bow and black for text/stems
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the reds against a low-value, neutral background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Mix of geometric extended sans-serif and transitional serif
letterConstructionRules: Main title uses wide, uniform stroke weights with open counters
Secondary text uses high-contrast serifs with thin hairlines
Diagonal accent text uses a condensed, slanted serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: Hyphens in the main title are elongated to match the wide letterforms
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme width contrast between the primary display face and the secondary serif face.

preserve: Extended width of the main title
High contrast of the serif body text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, geometric feel of the main title
Provides the classic mid-century serif contrast for body text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a cream-colored textured paper background. In the lower center, place a bouquet of overlapping red and orange hearts with visible gouache-like texture. The hearts are supported by thin, straight black lines meeting at a central point. The bouquet is tied with a thick, maroon, angular geometric bow made of straight segments.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, bold, extended geometric sans-serif title at the top center. Place secondary serif text in lowercase to the left and right of the bouquet's upper section. Add a small diagonal serif tag in red near the center.

verificationChecks: Is the bow geometric and angular rather than curvy?
Are the hearts overlapping with slight transparency effects?
Is the main title significantly wider than it is tall?
Is the background a warm cream rather than pure white?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible and follows the hierarchy
Check that the bow remains angular and stylized
Verify the cream background has a subtle paper texture
Confirm the hearts have a hand-painted gouache appearance
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a centered, stylized floral/heart graphic with a geometric ribbon anchor and high-contrast, wide-set typography for a mid-century modern editorial look.
